plugins.description: Turns Claude Code into a reliable engineering partner. Crash-recoverable TDD pipeline, pull-model knowledge base, architecture decision store, and codebase curation that detects stale decisions, knowledge gaps, and implicit dependencies. Your project learns across sessions — each feature makes the next one faster, and curation keeps the knowledge honest.
